summary: A workflow step that runs git clone of a first-party repo, or pip-installs one from a git+ URL, without a 40-hex or ${VAR} pin fails the build; multi-line command blocks are read as one; suppress with a reasoned # unpinned-ok marker.
changelog: - New gate `workflow_installs_pinned` (hard, no advisory mode): a CI `git clone` with no `checkout` of a 40-hex SHA or ${VAR} in the same command block, or a `git+https://` install with no `@<40-hex>` or `@${VAR}`, fails. Block scalars (`run: |`, `install-command: |`) are read as one block. Suppress with `# unpinned-ok: <reason>`.
owner_actions: Add a [[gate]] entry for workflow_installs_pinned to src/py_ci_shared/registry.toml and a README catalogue row (owner-owned files; not edited here).

Measured corpora are the two consumer workflow directories only; the social consumer (2 hits per the round file, unpinned `pyutilz @ git+` in production-scrapers-ci.yml) is not in the measured set and must be checked by the owner.
